licence.scope: Step 2 (owner's data terms): NASA Science Data Portal licence statement for data from NASA-led missions, applied to the MESSENGER Mercury Dual Imaging System narrow-angle camera (NASA mission, JHU/APL). No MESSENGER-specific credit line was found on the PDS Geosciences MESSENGER page or messenger.jhuapl.edu, so no acknowledgement is recorded. ; it does not cover third-party material marked with a restrictive notice. Same statement and class as Cassini__ISS_NAC, Dawn__FC, Galileo__SSI. Source page SVO cites: https://solarsystem.nasa.gov/missions/messenger/in-depth/ (curves from the PDS archive https://pdsimage2.wr.usgs.gov/archive/mess-e_v_h-mdis-4-cdr-caldata-v1.0/MSGRMDS_2001/).
